description_en: The protagonist becomes a permanent corporate display while remaining officially associated with the company.
legal_status: Corporate Asset or Contractual Post-Mobile Citizen
designer_notes: HR insists this counts as retention.

description_en: Employer-sponsored preservation permanently stabilizes the protagonist; the procedure succeeds according to the contract.
designer_notes: Success is defined contractually.

description_en: The protagonist becomes part of a recognized museum collection.
allowed_materials: wood; marble; crystal; porcelain; glass; synthetic; compatible other
ownership: Museum; Self with museum custody; Disputed
designer_notes: Prestige does not imply autonomy.

description_en: The protagonist survives indefinitely through regular conservation work and becomes progressively maintained or modified.
designer_notes: Condition-report terminology becomes the joke.

description_en: The protagonist's crystal structure preserves information unusually well, making the Permanent Form both person-history and archive.
designer_notes: Information preservation does not imply conscious experience.

description_en: The protagonist retains recognized ownership and substantial legal control over her Permanent Form.
designer_notes: Favorable legal outcome; still permanent.

description_en: The law determines that the protagonist has become part of real property; ownership follows the building or land.
designer_notes: Rare awareness overrides can make this substantially darker.

description_en: A creditor's claim against the protagonist's projected Permanent Form becomes enforceable.
allowed_materials: precious metal; gemstone; valuable stone; compatible other
designer_notes: The valuation was accurate.

description_en: A debt-for-preservation arrangement eliminates the protagonist's financial obligations by creating a different sort of obligation.
designer_notes: Outstanding Debt: 0.

description_en: The protagonist remains physically within the family across generations.
designer_notes: Tone can range from affectionate to possessive.

description_en: The protagonist's permanent placement is a family garden or courtyard.
designer_notes: May be loved, ignored, or seasonally decorated.

description_en: The protagonist becomes an official civic memorial; the word 'living' survives mainly in administrative language.
legal_status: Protected Permanent Citizen or Municipal Property
ownership: Government or Self under public custody
designer_notes: Rare awareness variants are explicit overrides, not default.

description_en: After political circumstances change, officials retain the protagonist while removing nearly all information about what she originally represented.
designer_notes: Historical context is administratively simplified.

description_en: The protagonist becomes a literal part of infrastructure or architecture.
typical_forms: column; support; facade element; structural figure
legal_status: Fixture Attached to Land or Corporate/Municipal Asset
designer_notes: Employment may technically remain active.

description_en: The protagonist acquires permanent academic status shortly before acquiring permanent physical status.
allowed_materials: stone; bronze; crystal; wood; compatible other
designer_notes: The institution finally guarantees her position.

description_en: The protagonist becomes the most convincing evidence in her own research.
designer_notes: Her paper may continue receiving citations.

description_en: The protagonist undergoes deliberate mid-life preservation marketed as locking in her best self.
designer_notes: Mid-life crisis industrialized.

description_en: Permanent preservation works at remarkably low cost; the expense reappears in rights, placement, maintenance, or aesthetics.
allowed_materials: synthetic; temporal; low-cost stone/ceramic; compatible other
designer_notes: T1026 synergy. Synthetic is not inherently cheap.

description_en: A religious institution recognizes the protagonist as sacred property while civil authorities dispute whether she remains a legal person.
allowed_materials: wood; marble; crystal; obsidian; ceremonial metal
designer_notes: Sacred and litigated.

description_en: The protagonist enters indefinite temporal fixation; no subjective time passes while outside obligations continue.
designer_notes: Elapsed legal time and experienced time diverge.

description_en: Conversion causes the protagonist's assessed financial value to stabilize or increase.
designer_notes: An accountant calls this an improvement.

description_en: The protagonist intentionally or accidentally becomes a recognized multi-material work.
designer_notes: Requires explicit authored mixed-material transition.

description_en: The protagonist remains subjectively herself despite substantial later alteration to the Permanent Form.
designer_notes: Requires T1028 or explicit equivalent. Not invulnerability.

description_en: The body reaches permanent solidification while consciousness does not remain bound to it.
designer_notes: Requires T1029 or explicit equivalent.
